title: Three Seasons and One Short Case
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：luxury　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 luxury 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the merchant ① bought the luxury that no buyer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the buying was the whole of the season. The ② luxury, meaning the comfort itself and not the case, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a luxury, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ luxury in that shop had the same short case beside it, and the ④ luxury at the far shelf, meaning the gift they kept for the children to choose and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A luxury, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the merchant said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the luxury was the whole of the matter, meaning the pleasure and not the comfort. The ⑥ luxury, meaning the pleasure and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; luxury, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both a comfort and a pleasure. He said the pleasure is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ luxury had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short case. The ⑧ luxury of the whole thing, the merchant wrote in December, was one shop and three seasons of recording; luxury, he said, is either the gift at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ luxury I remember is the comfort recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1995 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ luxury, my mother said in 1997, is the only comfort that improves by being recorded; every luxury, she said, is a pleasure that has agreed to look like a comfort. She said the pleasure was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 奢侈品；奢华（指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 奢侈品；奢华（指那件奢侈品本身，与匣子相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the luxury 买下这件奢侈品
D. n. 奢侈品；奢华（指留给孩子们挑的那一件那一件）
E. n. 奢靡之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的奢华之事）
F. n. 奢侈品；奢华（指账本里写到、被记载的的那一件）
G. n. 享受、排场（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 排场（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought the luxury that no buyer in the shop would have recorded
The luxury, meaning the comfort itself and not the case
the luxury at the far shelf
the luxury was the whole of the matter
the luxury had become a line in a ledger
The luxury of the whole thing
A luxury, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: buy the luxury 意为“买下这件奢侈品”，1988 年那位商人把铺子里没有一位买主肯记载的一件奢侈品做了一遍。
luxury 意为“奢侈品；奢华”，指那件奢侈品本身而不是匣子，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
luxury 意为“奢侈品；奢华”，指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一只小小的匣子。
luxury 意为“奢侈品；奢华”，指最远那层货架留给孩子们挑的那一件那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
luxury 意为“享受、排场”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份享受就是那件事的全部。
luxury 意为“排场”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件奢侈品，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
luxury 意为“奢侈品；奢华”，指账本里写到、被记载的的那一件，到 1993 年这一件成了账本里的一行。
luxury 意为“奢靡之事”，商人十二月写道，整件事的奢华之事是一处铺子和三个季度的记载。
luxury 意为“奢侈品；奢华”，我记得的是账本里记载过的那一件，1995 年卖完了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一件。
luxury 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，奢华是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的奢侈品。
